#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;

const ll MOD = 998244353;

struct Mod998 {
    static vector<ll> fact;
    static vector<ll> invFact;

    static ll mod() { return MOD; }

    static ll normalize(ll x) {
        x %= MOD;
        if (x < 0) x += MOD;
        return x;
    }

    static ll add(ll a, ll b) {
        ll v = a + b;
        return v < MOD ? v : v - MOD;
    }

    static ll subtract(ll a, ll b) {
        ll v = a - b;
        return v < 0 ? v + MOD : v;
    }

    static ll mult(ll a, ll b) {
        return (a * b) % MOD;
    }

    static ll mult(ll a, ll b, ll c) {
        return mult(mult(a, b), c);
    }

    static ll inv(ll value) {
        ll g = MOD, x = 0, y = 1;
        ll r = value;
        while (r != 0) {
            ll q = g / r;
            g %= r;
            swap(g, r);
            x -= q * y;
            swap(x, y);
        }
        return normalize(x);
    }

    static ll fact(int n) {
        while ((int)fact.size() <= n) {
            fact.push_back(mult(fact.back(), (int)fact.size()));
        }
        return fact[n];
    }

    static ll fInv(int n) {
        if ((int)invFact.size() > n) return invFact[n];
        int lastKnown = (int)invFact.size() - 1;
        int need = n - lastKnown;
        vector<ll> tmp(need);
        tmp[0] = inv(fact(n));
        for (int i = 1; i < need; i++) {
            tmp[i] = mult(tmp[i-1], n - i + 1);
        }
        for (int i = need - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            invFact.push_back(tmp[i]);
        }
        return invFact[n];
    }

    static ll ncr(int n, int r) {
        if (r < 0 || n < r) return 0;
        return mult(fact(n), mult(fInv(r), fInv(n - r)));
    }

    static ll smallInv(int n) {
        return mult(fInv(n), fact(n - 1));
    }
};

vector<ll> Mod998::fact = {1};
vector<ll> Mod998::invFact = {1};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;

    Mod998::fInv(n + m);

    ll phaseSize = 1;
    ll p = 1;
    for (int i = 0; p != 0; i++) {
        p = Mod998::mult(p, n - i, Mod998::smallInv(n + m - i));
        phaseSize = Mod998::add(phaseSize, p);
    }

    ll answer = 0;
    for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
        ll numPhases = Mod998::mult(m + k, Mod998::smallInv(k));
        ll e = Mod998::mult(numPhases, phaseSize);
        ll term = Mod998::mult(Mod998::ncr(n, k), e);
        if (k % 2 == 1)
            answer = Mod998::add(answer, term);
        else
            answer = Mod998::subtract(answer, term);
    }

    cout << answer << "\n";

    return 0;
}
